I have seen this stylized as Boney M featuring Liz Mitchell and the backdrop said Liz Mitchell Original Lead Singer Of Boney M. Samantha Fox dancing around onstage for most of the last 2 songs but didn't sing.



There was just SO MUCH this weekend and often conflicting events that targeted the exact same audience. For example, Saturday had Lost 80's, Culture Club/Berlin and night one of this event while I opted for a completely off the radar Bowie tribute event. Who's idea was it to do that? I decided to just opt for the least expensive. I had previously watched with interest as the final price for a Metallica 2 day ticket hit $53 plus fees and again Sunday afternoon when free tickets were outnumbering for sale posts. Just heading out there on Sunday even though the songs I wanted to hear the most were stacked toward night one seemed a little pointless in light of the effort required. I had been dragging all week and this is close with some rare acts and I wouldn't be surprised if this tour didn't get much coverage at all.

I really wanted a Samantha Fox recording though I had to refamiliarize myself who she was again. I was a little leery about using my usual method to obtain access at this venue and sure enough, 3 people walked in with their spares rather than accept my not quite face value cash offers. Finally more than halfway thru BBB someone gave me one and refused the money. I believe there was another unannounced opener onstage from 7 to 7:10.

She was really fun to watch if you know what I mean. I heard some complaints about her voice but anymore in the popsphere that just means she's really singing. The sound for Liz Mitchell was much better but this was left stack and that was right stack so I am also wondering if it was imbalanced somehow. Seen it happen.

Autographed shirts were $20 or 2 for $30!

No idea if Paul Stanley was there but not sure I would recognize him without his wig now he is the same age as my infirm grandpa in his final years.

This venue is on the lip of the foothills and some bears recently moved into the neighborhood causing quite a stir making use of swimming pools and the like. Turns out they are tagged and tracked, an adult and 2 cubs near maturity. Perhaps they were on the outskirts enjoying the music.
